message: Generated from Stimulation_2emg.hex Debug build on 2026-07-05. Firmware exposes independent ADC2 PPG and ADC3 noise sampling controls: ADC2RATE sets the 25-100 Hz PPG/LED frame, while ADC3RATE sets the 25-1000 Hz ADC3 noise decimation from the 1 ms SAADC base tick. RATE? reports ADC2_HZ, ADC2_FRAME_MS, ADC3_HZ, ADC3_MS, SAADC_BASE_HZ, and related limits. SAADC channels are not reinitialized for rate changes; only software frame/decimation intervals are updated.
